items.title: ENA unlock: 93,750,000 ENA (0.625% of supply) · Core contributors (30% of supply) + amount not published · Investors
items.summary: The page puts core contributors at 30% of ENA, locked on a one-year cliff at which 25% unlocks, then vesting monthly over three years, with schedules starting at the March 5, 2024 TGE. So 30% × 75% ÷ 36 = 0.625% of supply per month from April 2025 to March 2028. The page doesn't name the day of the month. The page gives investors the same terms as core contributors (one-year 25% cliff, then three years of monthly vesting). Their share of supply wasn't confirmed on the page, so no amount is shown.

items.title: MORPHO: Founders (15.2% of supply): vesting ends; Strategic partners, cohort 3: vesting ends
items.summary: The docs say all co-founders relocked to a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from the earlier of the transferability date (November 21, 2024) or May 17, 2025. The whitepaper gives the same 12-month cliff (November 21, 2025) and full vesting by November 21, 2027 in one passage, though another passage says May 2028. The docs list this cohort at 6.7%, on a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from November 21, 2024. The whitepaper puts the round at 6.23%. The two official figures disagree, so no amount is shown.

headlines.summary: Tokenized Take-Two shares drew $249.5 million in DEX volume Wednesday, nearly three times the $88.1 million for tokenized Nvidia shares.

headlines.title: North Korean hackers used Sky's stablecoin system, putting billions at freeze risk
headlines.summary: Blockchain investigation traced $518 million in illicit-linked activity, including the 2025 Bybit hack, through a key reserve backing DAI and USDS tokens, putting Sky's institutional finance ambitions and open design on collision course.

headlines.title: Anthropic’s $107 billion sale set to top SpaceX’s IPO as tokenized stocks gain traction
headlines.summary: The maker of Claude priced its Nasdaq debut at $83 a share for a $1.5 trillion fully diluted valuation, with the Nasdaq 100 down 14% from record highs.

headlines.title: 1inch integrates Hyperliquid’s perpetual futures contracts into its dApp and wallet platform
headlines.summary: Users can fund a position with a token they already hold on 1inch, which will be routed to USDC and deposited to a balance on Hyperliquid.

headlines.title: Singapore settles $77.5 million tokenized bill sale in local CBDC
headlines.summary: The central bank aims to expand this digital settlement network and test wider collateral use in 2027.

headlines.title: Ant International launches protocol for real-time settlement between tokenized deposits and money market funds
headlines.summary: Ant launched the Whale Orchestration Protocol to enable settlement between tokenized deposits and tokenized money market funds.
